text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we must speak. Feast your eyes
upon this divine machine bestowed by Zeus!

What she showed me was...
a video of a bartender juggling bottles with ease
as he served drinks.
choice_data_list: A-Amazing... To think such a technique existed...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha!! Do you see it too?!
This technique!! This madness born from years of devotion!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This is the thrill I've been seeking!!
A piece of the map that leads all the way to El Dorado!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, Trainer! I, too,
have decided to gaze into this abyss!
choice_data_list: If it's you, Gimlet, I know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Practice with the makeshift vessel is already flawless.
All that remains is to see it through with the crystal-clear real thing.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, prepare it for me.
The right to challenge the Hydra!!
On the day of the challenge, an array of various glass bottles was lined up before Tanino Gimlet's eyes.
choice_data_list: Feel free to use this place however you like today!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh heh... You're permitting this, Trainer? Knowing that for my sake, you'll become the ferryman across the Styx—or perhaps the Acheron.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "From this moment, I shall challenge the underworld. If you wish to seize the key of Aeacus, now is your only chance."
choice_data_list: Of course not! I would never stop you from taking on a challenge!
Of course not! I would never stand in the way of your challenge.

text_block_list.text: I negotiated with the academy and secured permission to use the kitchen. In doing so, I removed anything that might get damaged... taking every possible precaution.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
......Heh.
Then let the curtain rise!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!! Flare up!
O Flame of Prometheus! The kindle of humanity!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! Swallowed by the great flood, are we?
How fortuitous!! Sweep up the audience and stoke the frenzy even higher!!
Reach out, oh Ark!! Unto Parnassus!!
Not a hint of danger. She juggled and handled real bottles just like an acrobat—!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Hah! No. The praise that reaches
the constellations is not mine to claim."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...As I thought, it really is you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... How about it? A drink as a token of my thanks.
On my tab, naturally.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Then, to our next intoxication—cheers.

I took a sip of the drink Tanino Gimlet ordered for me.
Afterwards, I talked about what she
had accomplished today.
choice_data_list: You're one step closer to your dream now!
You're one step closer to your dream now!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... my phantasm. The rainbow bridge guiding the world.
Regarding that... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I want to devote myself to the same dream as you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
True intoxication doesn't depend on whether there's alcohol.
—I'll shower the world with myself to prove it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Playing at Dionysus, the fleeting moment where all are intoxicated...
That is the unreachable peak.
That is the new world I must one day offer to the lost sheep!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "What is needed for that? It's already obvious."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes caring for me, deceiving me—guiding me!
Trust, affection. Showing me a brand-new dream————

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It's you!! The one who understands me—and whom I understand!
The one who knows me best, practically my other half!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ――Now, come with me.

I appreciated the gesture, but the completely unexpected request made me flinch...!
I wanted a moment to think, but—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I cannot permit that. Time is finite.
Before the goddess of the night departs, come!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... You already know the answer anyway, don't you? Then swallow your reason! Give voice to your impulses!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Before you sober up from this intoxication!

I take another sip of the mocktail in my hand.
The sharp aroma of lime drifted past my nose.
I want to witness Tanino Gimlet's dream by her side. I had felt that way for a long time. So—

Even if this was just the intoxicating rush she brought on...
before the spell could fade, I opened my mouth to speak.
"Together with you, I will also—"
"‘Together with you, I will also—’"
